timing_interpretation: Bounds describe reviewed encoded-image states, not empirical physical accuracy or confidence intervals.
No exact point event times, interpolation, hidden positions or physical RPM are supplied.
Seven attempts within one draw are not seven independent draw-level samples.

Native before/after crops were inspected individually for ramp proxies. Other visible-state onsets use native-crop contact sheets at every six encoded frames; graphic onsets use overview samples every sixty frames.
Control/collector/ramp/graphic are separate definitions. Camera cuts and missing upper-collector views do not become precise capture selection times.

mixer_start.note: First clear close-up with balls visibly moving after control view. Actual mixer-start transition is not continuously visible; this is an upper bound/first observed mixing state, not an exact start timestamp.

events.note: Electrical command onset is not observed. Button-view samples, where present, do not bound actual contact/command; no electrical log or synchronized audio reviewed.
Outlet is first shown with a ball already in the collector; mechanism onset occurred off-view or is unresolved.
Ball already present at first usable outlet shot; do not manufacture a preceding empty collector from a control-panel camera shot.
Internal one-way gate/selection plane and irreversibility are not visible. A visibly held ball is not proof of permanent isolation.

Leading ball silhouette becomes visibly extended beyond front housing/post edge toward downstream ramp. Native endpoints checked individually. Wider than one frame where blur makes a touching silhouette ambiguous. Screen-space proxy only; not final seated-ball time, 3D crossing, permanent isolation or electrical selection time.

motion_transfer.note: Rotor close-up is substantially tighter than pilot: outer chamber is clipped by frame and hub diameter is much larger. Locked annulus would cover a different radial fraction. Native reference reviewed; no recenter/rescale or motion run.

changed_camera_details: First transfer uses longer ramp view; subsequent outlet close-up and ramp cameras switch. For event inspection only, crops are source x1400,y80,w520,h720 for attempt1 and x800,y180,w1100,h700 for attempts2–7. These are logged native-pixel viewing crops, not retuned motion ROIs. Every six-frame search is followed by one-frame bounded review near the ramp proxy.
